notes:
Early inbound from product-led signup. Founded 2024; building lightweight chat assistant SDK to embed inside partner SaaS apps (ticketing, HR tools). Developer team of 3 backend + 2 frontend on ReactNative. Signed up via self-serve, used free credits to run basic streams. Key points from discovery call:
- Wants streaming websocket + chunked tokens to render typing UI; latency target 120-200ms for first token under typical 2-3 message context.
- Currently using open-source LLM locally for dev; looking to move to hosted API for reliability and QA.
- Cost sensitive: expects 200k monthly tokens at launch, plans to optimize with prefix caching and batch/sampling.
- Security: SSO (SAML) required for admin portal; audit logs and 30d retention for conversation history; some EU customers require data residency.
- Model preferences: prefers Llama 2 style open models or comparable, wants fallback to smaller quantized variant when latency spikes.
- Interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations (cost/perf) but will start with hosted API.
- Quoted: "We need the typing experience to feel instant — 150ms feels like a hard barrier for product market fit."
- POC: implemented basic integration, measured 180ms median first-token on dev region using Redwood hosted sandbox. Concern about consistent SLO under concurrency (50 concurrent users).
- Security review: submitted preliminary questionnaire; legal asked for SOC2 in next 2 weeks.
- Next: SE to send sample streaming webhook & suggested rate-limit config; product team to run a canary load test next week.
- Stubs: call recording (ff_2026-02-10_01), thread with legal (179a3b2c4d5e6f7g8h0_thread), internal note to follow up on INF-842 (support ticket for rate limit doc).
